svg.aria-label: Output of release_timeline.py: Steam deadlines worked out backwards from a release date

text.tspan: 2027-02-16 Steamworks account, tax interview, USD 100 fee recommended (check takes up to 15 business days)
2027-03-09 Submit store page for review recommended
2027-03-16 Demo public (feedback before the fest) recommended
2027-03-18 Coming Soon page public recommended (6 months before)
2027-05-10 Submit demo for review (press preview) hard if press preview wanted
2027-05-13 Submit store page (must be public for the fest) hard for Next Fest
2027-05-24 Submit demo for review at the latest hard (3 weeks)
2027-08-20 Fee paid at the latest hard (21-day wait, before store review)
2027-08-20 Submit store page at the latest hard (7 business days)
2027-08-31 Coming Soon page public at the latest hard (2 weeks)
2027-09-03 Submit release build and launch discount hard (7 business days)
Note: re-check values in the Steamworks docs before committing to a plan.
